name: public-safe-local-demo
description: A minimal public-safe demo profile for the packaged CLI surface.
workflow: pdf-to-json-rag plan-query --query "What does this file cover?" --json
pdf-to-json-rag answer-query --query "What does this file cover?" --json
pdf-to-json-rag smoke-check --pdf /tmp/pdf-to-json-rag-demo.pdf --query "What does this file cover?" --json
recommended_queries: What kind of document is this?
What is the purpose of this file?
Which file is most relevant for drought triggers?
notes: This profile is intended for first-time public users.
It avoids private benchmark PDFs and ignored local artifacts.
